'''Winsafra The Wrecking Machine that is, JEDI COUNCIL''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Winsafra]]
* '''Published:''' 8 February 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Plead My Case To The Senate
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Senate Winsafra LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Jedi Council, revamped and redone completely after all the new sets :)

== Strategy ==

First off, get your force generation up fast. pull yoda witht the  chamber, and try and get out at least 1 other jedi master. use padme to her full extent(jedi protection). If you can, hold the senate, palpy and valorrum are your too main guys(cancelling battle destinies and adding a battle destiny to power? YES) Make sure you get either plo koon or mace to the chamber, they both rock. if your opponent is trying to fight you, get plo koon, if he's hiding in space or whatever, use mace to make him lose force from padme :P

If he's ssavin stuff up in his hand, grimtaash him! thats what its for :) and its so much fun. other than that, the strategy changes with each opponent, and if he's space, try and get out 1 ship or 2 to beat him down, but make sure to lose everyone so they can't get slaughtered the next turn :P
